settings.name: OIDF_FAPI2_CLIENTS
settings.description: The FAPI clients, space- or comma-separated; * is every client. The FAPI 2.0 filter holds them to issuer-only assertion audiences and PS256, ES256 or EdDSA DPoP proofs, and at UserInfo the resource-server filter sets x-fapi-interaction-id for them and refuses their access tokens in the query

when_wrong.detail: A list of nothing (a comma alone): FAPI does not start. An id that names no client holds nobody
